Meeting Format
Prepare Your Questions
Before each meeting, identify one specific need or blocker you'd like help with from the community. This ensures focused, productive discussions.
Participate Actively
Our structured format includes welcome introductions, a round-robin where everyone speaks briefly, a featured deep-dive presentation, and action planning.
Apply What You've Learned
Leave with concrete actions, sharable code, and fresh ideas. Our agentic assistant transcribes each session for private reference within the group.

Frequently Asked Questions
Is there a cost to join?
No financial cost, but we do expect consistent participation and contribution. Members should attend regularly and actively engage in our knowledge-sharing ecosystem.
What skill level is required?
You should be comfortable reading or writing agent task files (YAML/JSON) and directing multi-agent flows. We welcome varying expertise levels, but everyone should have hands-on experience.
Can I invite colleagues or friends?
Yes, but only after you've attended at least one session yourself and confirmed they meet our criteria for active involvement in multi-agent systems development.
How are session recordings used?
Audio recordings are stored privately. Transcripts and summaries are used to create a community agentic that will help our community thrive and grow.
